metadata.case_name: PUN TUNG KING v. WONG SING FAT

plaintiff.occupation_before: waitress and general assistant in her husband's restaurant

injuries.description: 10-cm oblique laceration on the posterior aspect of left calf with the subcutaneous fat and underlying muscle fascia exposed
source: The plaintiff suffered a 10-cm oblique laceration on the posterior aspect of her left calf with the subcutaneous fat and underlying muscle fascia exposed.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

injuries.description: Three wounds on right calf, each measuring 1 to 2 cm
source: There were three wounds, each measuring 1 to 2 cm long, on her right calf.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple open wounds of lower leg

source: the plaintiff hasbeen suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) as a result of the accident.
Based on available medical documents, Dr Lai was satisfied that the plaintiff was suffering from PTSD caused by the accident.

manifestations.description: moderate to severe intermittent pain in both legs
skin rash (likely pre-existing varicose vein not related to the accident)
diffuse tenderness over the whole of her left leg
reduced range of movement of the ankle
weakness in both legs, preventing standing or walking for a long time or lifting or carrying heavy objects
social estrangement / avoidance behaviour (avoidance of dogs of substantial size)
lack of self-confidence and reduced participation in recreational activities

treatments_received: multiple operations including debridement and skin closure
psychotherapy at the Department of Clinical Psychology of Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital (4 sessions)
treatment at a psychology unit of the Social Welfare Department
treatment by a clinical psychologist (9 sessions)
treatments_future: a further course of eight sessions of psychotherapy

losses.description: Weakness in both legs preventing standing or walking for a long time and reduced ability to lift or carry heavy objects
Scars and disfigurement of both legs following multiple lacerations and skin closure
Unable to resume pre-accident job as beverage counter worker and waitress and had to take up sedentary work such as a cashier

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Fear of dogs of substantial size and avoidance behaviour when going out

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Reduced participation in recreational activities due to psychiatric symptoms
